# Module collation

[Source](../../src/diesel/collation/mod.rs.html#1-127)

Expand description

This module contains types that represent SQL collations.

These types are used as arguments for
[`TextExpressionMethods::collate`](../expression_methods/trait.TextExpressionMethods.html#method.collate).

## Structs[§](#structs)

[Binary](struct.Binary.html)`__sqlite-shared`The `BINARY` collation.[C](struct.C.html)`postgres_backend`The `C` collation.[Custom](struct.Custom.html)A custom collation.[NoCase](struct.NoCase.html)`__sqlite-shared`The `NOCASE` collation.[Posix](struct.Posix.html)`postgres_backend`The `POSIX` collation.[RTrim](struct.RTrim.html)`__sqlite-shared`The `RTRIM` collation.

## Traits[§](#traits)
